payload.friendly_name: Split built-in into foundation and writing
payload.purpose_context: Issue #73 (epic #190): per charter ADR-0048 d12 and ADR-0053 d3/d9, built-in stops holding artifacts and aggregates its members. The operator ruled foundation down to its bare basis (fallback, implementer, reviewer, analyst profiles and the base mission types), moved documentation work into writing, and parked the remaining specialist doctrine in a temporary org pack to be carved into bundles one PR at a time. Downstream stack packs (java, rust, go) depend on foundation.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make built-in a thin distribution pack that aggregates a strict foundation pack and a writing pack, with everything else parked in a staging pack.

payload.question: Which artifacts form the foundation pack?

payload.final_answer: Only the very basis: fallback generic profile (display name Generic Giannis), a reviewer, an implementer, an analyst, and the base mission types. No diagram/writer/architect, no language stacks; those become specialist bundles.

payload.question: Where does the documentation mission type bundle go?
What happens to qa/internal-bound items in this PR?
How do the org packs declare their dependency after the split?

payload.final_answer: Depend directly on foundation/writing (and staging where needed).

payload.question: Seeds plus required closure, or strict one-hop?

payload.final_answer: Strict: foundation keeps seeds plus directly referenced directives and tactics; other edges move into specialist packs as foundation::-sourced edges.

payload.question: Rename generic-agent id or display name only?

payload.final_answer: Display name only; id stays generic-agent.

payload.question: Create specialist bundles in this PR?

payload.final_answer: One PR per bundle; this PR parks the remainder in a temporary org pack specialist-staging that depends on foundation and writing.

payload.question: Cross-cutting directives not required by the seeds: foundation or specialist?

payload.final_answer: Keep in foundation; topical ones (disciplined-refactoring, C4, 039) go to staging.

payload.question: Approve the computed membership (foundation 115, writing 57, qa 6, internal 4, specialist-staging 217) and start phase 2?

payload.question: After the bundle squad: fold foundation's how-to layer (directive-required procedures/tactics, step-contract delegates) into foundation?
Which role-filling profiles belong in foundation (researcher-robbie, human-in-charge, retrospective-facilitator)?

payload.final_answer: human-in-charge only; researcher-robbie and retrospective-facilitator go to planning-analysis (roles fall back to Generic Giannis).
Drop the body reference; declare the edge in writing's graph.
Glossary group only; diagram-daisy drops its C4 directive reference, the edge is declared in architecture.
Opt-in testing bundle; qa's mutation/gherkin items join it; stacks and qa depend on it.

payload.question: How are the specialist bundles created?

payload.final_answer: Carve all bundles in this PR; no specialist-staging pack.

payload.question: Approve the computed map (foundation 178, writing 68, ten bundles; git-delivery folded into foundation; DISCIPLINED_REFACTORING in foundation; java carved here)?
